items.t: Said House Democrats will look at statewide wildfire prevention needs and what the state Department of Land and Natural Resources needs to do a better job.
items.q: House Democrats will look at wildfire prevention needs statewide and develop an understanding of what the state Department of Land and Natural Resources needs in order to do a better job, Nakamura said.

items.t: Said the Maui fires exacerbated a longstanding problem of vacation rentals proliferating around the state.
items.q: Nakamura said the Maui fires exacerbated a problem that existed long before: the proliferation of vacation rentals around the state.

items.t: Said lawmakers could revisit previously failed legislation to give counties the authority to phase out short-term rentals.
items.q: Lawmakers could revisit legislation that has failed before that would give counties the authority to phase out short-term rentals, Nakamura said.

items.t: Said there will be a push for zoning that allows more housing on individual lots and for funding that subsidizes affordable housing development.
items.q: Nakamura said there will be a push for zoning to allow more housing on individual lots and for putting money into funds that subsidize affordable housing development.

items.t: Said Hawaii needs more shelter for residents, noting that business, tourism and health care leaders told her their workers need housing.
items.q: There is widespread understanding that Hawaii needs more shelter for residents, Nakamura said, relaying how she has talked to business leaders and people in the tourism and health care industries who say their workers need housing.

record.t: Was a primary sponsor, with State Senate President Ronald Kouchi, of the visitor lodging tax bill H.B.1077 / S.B.1396.
record.q: The primary sponsors of the bill were Hawaii House Speaker Nadine Nakamura and State Senate President Ronald Kouchi.
